exact_referrer_entries.raw_entry_text: CSC 312 Topics in Information Technology (3 Credits) Advanced Information Technology topics that are not generally covered in the curriculum. Designed as a Computer Science Applied Computing elective, not as a replacement for any specific required course. Course topic and syllabus must be approved by the Department Head.Prerequisites: Take CSC-311.

CSC 313 Network Administration (3 Credits) This course provides essential knowledge and skills required of network administrators. It includes an overview of TCP/IP protocols and how to properly configure and manage network services based on the protocols (including DNS, DHCP, AD/LDAP directory services, print and file servers, NFS/NIS, and routing services). It also has practical lab components for students to learn how to set up, configure, troubleshoot, and administer the network services in both Windows and Linux environments.Prerequisites: Take CSC-311.
